Admin.title: Admin
Admin.description: Authorized administrator account permitted to manage products and customer orders.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when admin entry was created.

Product.title: Product
Product.description: Standalone direct-sale product with its own dedicated Liquid Glass + 3D landing page at /p/{slug}.

slug.description: Unique URL-safe slug used as document ID and landing page route.

name.description: Product display title in Arabic or English.

compareAtPrice.description: Optional pre-discount price (0 when no discount applies).

currency.description: Currency symbol or label (e.g., ج.م, ر.س).

features.description: Bounded list (max 15 items) of key product benefits.

images.description: Bounded list (1 to 10 items) of product image URLs.

isActive.description: Whether the product landing page is publicly visible and accepting orders.

themeId.description: Optional landing page color palette preset.

model3dUrl.description: Optional GLB 3D model URL for interactive Three.js showcase.

whatsappNumber.description: Optional merchant WhatsApp number for floating direct contact button.

stockRemaining.description: Optional remaining units display counter (0 hides scarcity indicator).

showCountdown.description: Optional toggle to display offer countdown timer.

countdownMinutes.description: Duration in minutes for optional offer countdown (max 10080).

reviews.description: Optional bounded list (max 10 items) of customer testimonials.

faqs.description: Optional bounded list (max 10 items) of FAQ accordion entries.

createdBy.description: UID of the admin who created the product.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the product was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last product update.

Order.title: Order
Order.description: Cash-on-delivery customer order submitted from a product landing page.

productName.description: Snapshot of product name at time of order.

unitPrice.description: Verified product unit price at time of order.

currency.description: Currency symbol at time of order.

paymentMethod.description: Payment method, strictly cash on delivery (cod).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when order was submitted.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest status change.

/products/{slug}.description: Standalone products keyed by URL slug. Active items are publicly readable by exact slug only.

/orders/{orderId}.description: Customer COD orders. Publicly creatable for active products with price verification; strictly admin-only readable and updatable.
